Firm rest the feet below, clear gaze the eyes above, / When Truth, to point the way through Life, assumes the wand of Love.

—
Life a Temple
,
 ll. 38–39.

Margaret

Fuller

The Poets of Transcendentalism

An Anthology

Edited by George Willis Cooke

This small collection of 186 poems brings together the 42 major and minor authors of the great flowering of American verse.
